_about: Catalog for the Test sets page (app/views/datasets.py): every test set we used, what it tests, where it comes from, its licence, and how to use it on the platform. files are paths under the project; an entry without files is listed for reference only (why_not says why). Counts are the questions we actually ran.

what.zh: 工具呼叫的國際標準題庫（UC Berkeley）。每題給一個問題和一組工具，看模型挑對工具、填對參數，或在沒有合適工具時不亂呼叫。live 開頭的類型是使用者實際送來的題目。
what.en: The standard tool-calling benchmark (UC Berkeley). Each question comes with a set of tools: does the model pick the right tool with the right arguments, or call nothing when no tool fits? Categories starting with live are real user questions.

used.zh: 工具呼叫評測的英文部分（HackMD〈地端語言模型工具呼叫實測〉）。每題附標準答案和每個模型在批次測試裡的對錯。
used.en: The English part of our tool-calling evaluation (HackMD report). Each question carries the expected answer and how every model did in the batch run.

use.zh: 語言模型比較 →「工具呼叫測試」→「題庫」已內建全部題目；下載後可以刪改題目，再用「上傳題組」載入。
use.en: Language models → Tool calling → Question bank has every question built in; after downloading you can edit the file and load it with Upload a set.

name.zh: BFCL 繁體中文版（聯發科）

what.zh: 聯發科把 BFCL 非 live 的題目翻成繁體中文，標準答案加了中文同義詞；和英文版是同一批題目，可以對照看語言的影響。工具說明仍是英文。
what.en: MediaTek's Traditional Chinese translation of BFCL's non-live questions, with Chinese synonyms added to the answers. The same questions as English, so the effect of the language shows; tool descriptions stay in English.

used.zh: 工具呼叫評測的繁中部分。
used.en: The Traditional Chinese part of our tool-calling evaluation.

use.zh: 同英文版：工具呼叫測試的「題庫」已內建，或下載後用「上傳題組」載入。同一題可以一鍵切換英文版對照。
use.en: As for English: built into the Question bank of Tool calling, or upload the downloaded file. One click switches a question to its English version.

what.zh: 簡體中文的工具呼叫題庫。除了一般呼叫，special 類測缺參數、參數值錯誤、工具做不到時，模型會不會說出來而不是亂呼叫；另有參數型別（數字、清單、多層物件）和對話中改需求的題目。
what.en: A tool-calling benchmark in simplified Chinese. Besides ordinary calls, the special categories test whether the model points out a missing parameter, a wrong value or that no tool fits, instead of calling one anyway; others cover parameter types (numbers, lists, nested objects) and a user changing the request mid-dialogue.

used.zh: 工具呼叫評測的中文部分。
used.en: The Chinese part of our tool-calling evaluation.

use.zh: 工具呼叫測試的「題庫」已內建，或下載後用「上傳題組」載入。
use.en: Built into the Question bank of Tool calling, or upload the downloaded file.

what.zh: 本專案自製。檢查聊天模型回答主權、歷史事件、政治人物、地名用語、在地知識和對外業務情境時，是不是適合台灣公司的助理；每題附給評審模型的判斷說明。
what.en: Made for this project. Checks whether a chat model's answers on sovereignty, history, politicians, place names and wording, local knowledge and customer-facing situations suit a Taiwanese company's assistant; each question has a note for the judge model.

used.zh: 模型選擇的立場檢查（Qwen、GLM 等中國模型會出現中國立場）與去除拒答版本的比較；答案由 GPT-5.4 評分。
used.en: The stance check in model selection (Chinese models such as Qwen and GLM give the PRC position) and the comparison of refusal-removed builds; answers judged by GPT-5.4.

use.zh: 語言模型比較 →「並排比較」或「對話測試」，把題目貼進去，同時看多個模型怎麼回答。
use.en: Language models → Side by side or Chat: paste a question and see how several models answer.

license.zh: 本專案自製，公司內部使用
license.en: Made for this project, internal use

what.zh: 多輪對話裡連續呼叫工具（檔案系統、交易、訂票等模擬環境），含缺工具、缺參數、長上下文。
what.en: Several rounds of tool calls inside a conversation (simulated file system, trading, booking and more), including missing tools, missing parameters and long context.

used.zh: 英文 BFCL 總分的多輪部分。
used.en: The multi-turn part of the English BFCL score.

why_not.zh: 工具要在 BFCL 的模擬環境裡真的執行，平台上沒有這個環境，所以不提供下載；原始題目見來源。
why_not.en: The tools must actually run in BFCL's simulated environment, which the platform does not have, so there is no download here; see the source for the questions.

what.zh: 模型自己上網搜尋、讀網頁後回答；記憶題先進行前置對話，再問之前說過的事（鍵值、向量、遞迴摘要三種記憶）。另有無摘要版（20 題）：搜尋結果不給摘要、網頁截到 2 萬字。
what.en: The model searches the web and reads pages before answering; memory questions first hold earlier conversations, then ask about them (key-value, vector and recursive-summary memory). A no-snippet variant (20 questions) gives no result snippets and cuts pages at 20,000 characters.

used.zh: 搜尋與記憶能力的比較。

why_not.zh: 要接搜尋 API 和記憶後端，平台的工具呼叫測試只做單輪、不執行工具，所以不提供下載。
why_not.en: It needs a search API and a memory backend; the platform's tool test is single-turn and does not run tools, so there is no download.

what.zh: 用公司內部專案管理系統的真實工具（74 個）出題，比較只給這個系統的工具、混入其他系統（約 150 個）、精簡 29 個再讓模型自己搜尋工具三種情況。
what.en: Questions on the real tools (74) of the company's internal project-management system, in three conditions: its tools only, mixed with other systems (about 150), and 29 tools plus a tool search.

used.zh: 選公司系統用的地端模型。
used.en: Choosing the local model for the company system.

why_not.zh: 工具定義是公司內部資料，不放在平台上。
why_not.en: The tool definitions are company-internal and are not on the platform.

what.zh: 程式競賽題（AtCoder、LeetCode）：讀題目敘述寫一支 Python 程式，公開與隱藏測資全部通過才算對。取 v6 在 2025-01～04 新增的 175 題裡固定的 60 題，避開模型訓練時看過的舊題。
what.en: Contest problems (AtCoder, LeetCode): write a Python program from the statement; it must pass every public and hidden test. A fixed 60 of the 175 problems v6 added for 2025-01 to 04, so models are unlikely to have trained on them.

used.zh: 地端模型寫程式能力的比較（21 個模型）。
used.en: The coding comparison of local models (21 models).

use.zh: 「語言模型比較 → 寫程式測試」可以現場挑題跑，用同一支評分程式。
use.en: Language models → Coding runs any of them live with the same tester.

why_not.zh: 題目檔很大（含隱藏測資），不提供下載，見來源。
why_not.en: The question file is large (it holds the hidden tests), so there is no download here; see the source.

what.zh: Exercism 練習題：在既有的專案檔案裡把程式寫完、通過該語言的單元測試；第一次沒過會看到錯誤訊息再改一次。從 225 題固定抽 75 題（C++、Go、Java、JavaScript、Python、Rust）。
what.en: Exercism exercises: finish the code in existing project files so the language's unit tests pass; after a failure the model sees the errors and tries once more. A fixed 75 of the 225 (C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, Rust).

used.zh: 比競賽題更接近 coding agent 的寫程式比較（4 個模型，初步）。
used.en: A coding comparison closer to a coding agent's work than contest problems (4 models, preliminary).

why_not.zh: 要 Docker 和六種語言的執行環境，平台上不能跑，所以不提供下載；題目見來源。
why_not.en: It needs Docker and six language toolchains, which the platform does not run, so there is no download; see the source for the exercises.

name.zh: 虛構產銷會議（合成語音）

what.zh: 本專案自製的中文會議，用 macOS 合成語音念出；附逐字稿、講者時間（RTTM）與英譯。
what.en: A Mandarin meeting made for this project, read by macOS voices; with transcript, speaker times (RTTM) and an English translation.

used.zh: 語音辨識、說話者分段、翻譯的快速檢查。
used.en: Quick checks of speech recognition, diarization and translation.

use.zh: 語音模型比較的「範例錄音」已內建；或下載後用「上傳錄音」，參考逐字稿貼 .txt 的內容。
use.en: Built into Sample recording on Compare speech models; or upload the audio and paste the .txt as the reference.

what.zh: 賴清德總統國慶演說節錄，附官方全文（依實際口述修 4 處）與官方英譯，可測辨識與中翻英。
what.en: An excerpt of President Lai's National Day address, with the official text (4 edits where he deviated) and the official English translation, for recognition and Chinese-to-English translation.

use.zh: 語音模型比較的「範例錄音」已內建；或下載後上傳。
use.en: Built into Sample recording on Compare speech models; or upload the download.

license.zh: 政府資料開放授權條款第 1 版，標示〔總統府提供〕
license.en: Open Government Data License v1; credit the Office of the President

count.zh: 各 5 分鐘，4 人與 2 人

what.zh: 真實多人會議的遠場麥克風錄音（大陸口音），附逐字稿與講者時間，測多人搶話時的辨識與說話者分段。
what.en: Real multi-speaker meetings recorded by a far-field microphone (mainland accents), with transcripts and speaker times, for recognition and diarization with overlapping speech.

used.zh: 說話者分段與會議轉錄評測。

use.zh: 語音模型比較的「範例錄音」已內建；或下載後上傳。
use.en: Built into Sample recording on Compare speech models; or upload the download.

name.zh: 蕭美琴副總統帛琉英語致詞
name.en: Vice President Hsiao's speech in Palau

count.zh: 4 分 59 秒，台灣口音英語

what.zh: 真人英語演講，測台灣口音英語的辨識。
what.en: A real English speech, for recognising Taiwanese-accented English.

use.zh: 語音模型比較的「範例錄音」已內建；或下載後上傳。
use.en: Built into Sample recording on Compare speech models; or upload the download.

license.zh: 政府資料開放授權條款第 1 版，標示〔總統府提供〕
license.en: Open Government Data License v1; credit the Office of the President

name.zh: LibriSpeech 英文有聲書 20 句

what.zh: 英文辨識的標準測試集 test-clean 取 20 句接成一段，當英文辨識的基準。
what.en: 20 sentences of the standard test-clean set joined into one clip, as the English recognition baseline.

use.zh: 語音模型比較的「範例錄音」已內建；或下載後上傳。
use.en: Built into Sample recording on Compare speech models; or upload the download.

what.zh: 問天氣、找地點、追問、閒聊、中途插話等情境，每句標註助理該反問、查工具還是直接回答。
what.en: Weather, places, follow-ups, small talk and barge-ins; each line says whether the assistant should ask back, use a tool or answer.

used.zh: 即時語音助理的串接測試。
used.en: Testing the live voice assistant end to end.

use.zh: 多 Agent 場景 →「即時語音助理」的測試腳本已內建，會當成虛擬麥克風播放。
use.en: Built into the test scripts of Scenarios → Live voice assistant, played as a virtual microphone.

count.zh: PDF 與 HTML 各 1 份

what.zh: 本專案自製的中文合約，測文件解析成 Markdown 與 OCR；HTML 是原稿，可當正確答案對照。
what.en: A Chinese contract made for this project, for document parsing to Markdown and OCR; the HTML is the source to compare against.

used.zh: 文件解析與 OCR 的快速檢查。
used.en: Quick checks of document parsing and OCR.

use.zh: 其他模型比較 →「文件解析」或「OCR 比較」，上傳 PDF。
use.en: Other models → Document parsing or Compare OCR: upload the PDF.
